title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: A licence outside your list, for the motion experiment only: may the free frame-smoother RIFE (MIT licence, its model weights stated MIT by their author) be used to turn the video model's slow clips into 60 frames a second for Epic's capture plugin? Nothing of it ships in the game; its notice is kept.

links.label: RIFE's Vulkan program (licence in the repository)
The weights' author (MIT stated in its README)

sections.recommendation: Yes: Epic's plugin wants 60 frames a second and our clips are 16 to 24; RIFE runs on your card and is the one option with a stated licence for its weights (the two others' weights state none). Ten seconds of your time.
